pp1.6:2.1: atthekacco puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati tattha ca sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇāti balesu ca vasībhāvaṃ
pp1.6:2.2: atthekacco puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni abhisambujjhati na ca tattha sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇāti na ca balesu vasībhāvaṃ
pp1.6:2.3: atthekacco puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni anabhisambujjhati diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti sāvakapāramiñca pāpuṇāti
pp1.6:2.4: atthekacco puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni anabhisambujjhati diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti na ca sāvakapāramiṃ pāpuṇāti
pp1.6:2.5: atthekacco puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni anabhisambujjhati na ca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti anāgāmī hoti anāgantvā itthattaṃ
pp1.6:2.6: atthekacco puggalo pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu sāmaṃ saccāni anabhisambujjhati na ca diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti sotāpannasakadāgāmī hoti āgantvā itthattaṃ.
